items.title: What Is Duke Energy (DUK) Changing With Joyce Mullen And Great Falls?
items.summary: Duke Energy (NYSE:DUK) appointed Joycelyn M. Mullen to its board of directors and key committees, effective 23 September 2026. Mullen, the CEO of Insight Enterprises, joins the audit, finance, and operations and nuclear oversight committees. The utility filed a regulatory application to decommission hydropower units at the Great Falls powerhouse within the Catawba Wateree Project. items.title: Duke Energy (DUK) Hits a 52-Week Low as the 30-Year Treasury Reaches a 2004 High
items.summary: Duke Energy Corporation (NYSE:DUK) closed at $113.23 on September 24, within a few cents of its lowest level in a year. Nothing went wrong at the company. The bond market moved instead. The 30-year Treasury yield closed at 5.47% that day, the highest since 2004. The 10-year reached 5.18%, a level last seen in 2007. […]

items.title: Why Dominion Energy Halted Dividend Growth Despite Strong Operating Performance
items.summary: Dominion Energy has kept its quarterly payout frozen for years while pouring billions into offshore wind and data center infrastructure, and now a pending merger with NextEra is forcing retirees to decide whether patience will finally be rewarded or replaced by a 5% Treasury yield.
